newsitem.title: USA: Sonus says delay in Echogen review.
newsitem.headline: Sonus says delay in Echogen review.

text.p: SONUS Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday that the June 30 meeting of the Medical Imaging Drugs Advisory Committee to review the EchoGen Emulsion new drug application has been postponed.
SONUS attributed the delay to a federal court injunction against the U.S. Food and Drug Administration resulting from the matter of Bracco Diagnostics Inc vs. Shalala.
"The delay of the advisory committee meeting is an anticipated outcome of the judicial matter," SONUS said.

SONUS said a court order of April 21 prohibits the FDA from continuing any approval or review procedures with respect to EchoGen and three other ultrasound contrast agents until 10 days after the FDA answers citizen petitions that have been filed by Bracco Diagnostics Inc, DuPont Merck Pharmaceutical Co and SONUS.

The citizen petition filed by SONUS asks that all ultrasound contrast agents be regulated as drugs through the Center for Drug Evaluation and Research rather than as devices through the Center for Devices and Radiological Health.
DuPont Merck is a joint venture of DuPont Co and Merck and Co Inc.
